name: Skinner v4.0.2 — UI Refinements, Clean Modal, Flat Dark Theme & Focused Presets
changelog: Three-Dots Preset Options Menu: Re-introduced dedicated ... button for slot renaming, duplicating, resetting defaults, and deleting.
Clean Minimalist Rename Modal: Removed close X and pencil icon, added comfortable button spacing.
Borderless Settings Close Button: Removed perimeter outline around settings close button.
Minimal Sidebar Navigation: Removed icons and blue box interactions, retaining only a crisp edge accent indicator.
Removed Redundant KO Effects Dropdown: Cleaned gallery header to focus purely on instant search.
Perfect Button Alignment: Vertically centered maintenance diagnostic repair button with sibling controls.
Completely Removed App Glow: Replaced fuzzy radial gradients and blue button halos with sleek flat dark theme styling.
